data.body: Fix: change 3369 (d06145796e3; make verify rc=0: 21,166 + 218 passed). The parser declares --only with choices=("stale-channel",) and help "with --repair, repair only stale-channel snapshots" (no more "named ticket(s)"); fsck_cli folds `--only <value>` into `--only=<value>`, so both spellings behave identically; the unknown-value error now names the one accepted value. A bare trailing --only still reports "requires a value". tests/unit/test_fsck_only_flag.py pins the help text and parser together (4 of 5 failed RED before the change). Choosing truthful help over per-ticket scoping: adding a per-ticket fsck filter is a feature, not this bug's fix.
